meta.description: The Super Smart Curtain, Smart Control edition: One Step™ voice control on the MixPad C switch, AI shading scenes, soft start and stop, a telescopic track that needs no measuring, and free home installation.
sec1.title: A new way to shade your home, truly smart
sec1.card: Open the curtains in three words
sec1.card2: With ORVIBO's own One Step™ voice interaction, the always-listening Super Smart Switch opens the curtains the moment you ask. Once you've tried it, you'll never pull them by hand again.
sec1.card3: Precise control, just as you see it
sec1.card4: The Super Smart Switch shows your curtains on its screen: drag them to set how far they open, and the real curtains follow.
sec1.card5: Close them from the app, even when you're out
sec1.card6: The ORVIBO Home app gives you remote control: if you forgot to close the curtains when you left, close them from your phone. Forgetting is no longer a problem.
sec2.title: The Super Smart Curtain kit
sec2.desc: A complete, made-to-order smart curtain kit: smart living in one step.
sec2.info: In the kit: Super Smart Switch ×1 | Ultra-quiet DC curtain motor ×1 | Measure-free telescopic track ×1
sec3.title: Truly smart AI shading control
sec3.content2: One tap lets the curtains of a west-facing room open by just the right amount for the time of day, keeping out the harsh afternoon sun. No more opening and closing them over and over.
sec3.content4: Room too bright? Tap “A sliver of sun” and the curtains open just a crack, letting in a single ray of sunlight for a calm, cozy mood.
sec3.content6: Fancy a nap? No alarm needed: tap “Afternoon nap” and the curtains close, then open half an hour later to wake you.
sec3.tips3: Close the curtains now, open them in 30 minutes.
sec4.title: Soft start and stop, silky-smooth running
sec4.desc: It eases in at every start and eases out at every stop, so sudden stops never strain the motor and every run looks more graceful.
sec5.title: A gentle tug sets it going, all the way
sec5.desc: When it's powered, pull the curtain about 5 cm and it starts moving on its own until it is fully open or closed. No extra effort, so opening and closing gets easier.
sec6.title: Pull it by hand, even in a power cut
sec6.desc: A built-in electromagnetic clutch means that even in a power cut you can open and close it by hand like an ordinary curtain, so nothing gets in your way.
sec7.title: Focused on smart living, chosen by more and more high-end developments
sec7.desc: Leading developers such as Fantasia, Evergrande, China Merchants and Gemdale choose us.
sec8.title: Installers all over China, always one near you
sec8.desc: New build or renovation, we provide a complete one-stop installation service. You get a full Super Smart Curtain without lifting a finger.
sec8.content2: We come to you anywhere in China
sec8.content4: Free repairs for any manufacturing defect for 2 years
sec9.title:
A high-quality aluminum alloy track
Smooth running, extra-long life
sec9.bg2: Polished in one piece with streamlined lines, it lasts and looks refined.
sec9.bg4: Nano rollers run steadily, smoothly and fluidly.
sec9.bg6: The thickened aluminum alloy track is solid and carries heavy curtains with ease.
meta.spec.description: Super Smart Curtain kit specifications: the MixPad C switch (4-inch screen, ARM Cortex-A35), the W10 ultra-quiet DC motor (36 W, 1.0 N·m) and the W13/W14 telescopic track (1.7–4 m, 20 kg).
